rule: Names are keyword templates: adjective or prefix, base noun, then a weighted keyword group ('of' phrases); weights default to 10; generated names capped at 25 characters and rerolled if longer; half of weapon and armour names use the table, the rest are random. Ancestor names come from culture-by-gender pools (17 cultures, male and female) plus a bland pool. Unidentified rings and amulets show appearance plus material. Sound events have seen and unseen wordings. Timed messages pick a countdown adjective from five remaining-time bands and a distance word from five distance bands; interval lines grow by a fixed ratio back from the end.
keep: Seen and unseen pair of wordings for one sound event (shout table: 24 unseen, 25 seen).
Countdown adjective that escalates as remaining time falls, plus a distance word (lm_tmsg.lua).
Weighted keyword templates with a length cap and reroll.
Culture-by-gender name pools with a bland fallback (monname.txt, 34 culture-gender pools).
Unidentified appearance (adjective plus material) hiding the real name until identified.
Graffiti signed by an author class, so a wall reads like a past visitor.
Zone as a branch-style card: title line plus a short paragraph (branches.txt, 37 blocks).
change: All words, names and adjectives: ours, not donor strings.
No god pantheon, no orc or Xom voice; our own factions.
Our own culture pools and our own distance and time bands.
Our own zone count and card length (700 zones, 3-4 lines at 375 wide).
Speech lines kept under one line each for the phone log.
look_test: Three cards only, published to the preview folder with no release rows: (1) a zone card with title, one wrapped line and a graffiti line signed by an author class; (2) a three-message countdown with the adjective rising from distant-and-slow to near-and-urgent; (3) an unidentified item pair, one hidden and one revealed. Dom judges on his phone whether the cards read as one place, whether the countdown works without a HUD timer, and whether the hidden name makes the find feel like a find.
licence_note: Code GPLv2 or later (LICENSE; README says GPLv2+). Text data under the general GPLv2+ statement (AU011 read the files). Donor numeric values are not usable (GPL, not MIT/Apache/BSD), so all donor_value_or_null entries are null. Inspiration is category-level only: a countdown with escalating adjectives, a seen/unseen pair, a culture-tagged name pool. No donor string or donor name is reproduced. No legal conclusions.
